Privacy & cookies

Short and simple.

What we store

This site saves one small setting in your browser: whether you accepted or declined cookies, so we don’t ask again. We don’t sell your information, and we don’t collect anything when you browse the menu.

If we add analytics later

If we ever add visitor stats to see which pages people use, it will only run if you click Accept. You can change your choice any time.
